system.description:
You make it difficult for enemies to Grab or Grapple you, or attack objects in your possession.

Effect: You get a +5 bonus to your Reflex Defense when an enemy makes a Grab or Grapple attack against you, and you get a +5 bonus to all opposed Grapple checks. All objects that you are holding or carrying gain a +5 bonus to their Reflex Defense when attacked (see Attack an Object).

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Legacy Era Campaign Guide
